title: Demo Campus Wi-Fi Guide

sections.title: Connecting
sections.text: Select the Acme-Campus demo Wi-Fi network and sign in with your demo account.

sections.title: Guest access
sections.text: Visitors use the Acme-Guest demo Wi-Fi network and the guest code supplied by their host.

sections.title: Connection troubleshooting
sections.text: If the demo Wi-Fi connection fails, forget the network and reconnect.
